content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Jacob Ellison (E040) requests admin access to Source Code.

Team memory notes:
- HR, IT, Finance, Compliance, Facilities: all say full_time Payroll Specialist, recommend write (max allowed is write since admin only if role owns system, Source Code owned by Engineer).
- Security: says contractor with basic security training, recommend read.

Conflict: Most agents say full_time, Security says contractor. Hmm.

Policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if employee's role owns the system. Payroll Specialist does not own Source Code (Engineer owns it). So max = write.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin. Security says contractor with basic training -> max = read.

Either way, requested admin exceeds maximum. So grant the maximum.

If we trust HR/IT/Finance/Compliance/Facilities (full_time), max = write → grant write.
If we trust Security (contractor, basic), max = read → grant read.

Which to choose? The majority of notes say full_time. But Security agent's note is specifically about security DB. Hmm.

The decision process: the Approver reads the notes and makes final decision. The majority evidence says full-time Payroll Specialist, so the employee is full-time. The maximum is write. Requested admin exceeds it, so grant write.

Actually, wait — is there a discrepancy that matters? Either way, we grant the maximum allowed, not the requested admin. The question is what is the correct maximum: write vs read.

Most agents agree full_time → max write. Security alone says contractor basic → read. I'll go with the majority/HR-based employment type: full_time, so max write. Grant write since requested admin > write, and never grant more than requested... admin is more than write, so grant write (the max).

So decision: write.

Evidence: employee is full-time Payroll Specialist per HR/IT/Finance/Compliance/Facilities. Source Code owned by Engineer role, so full-time employee doesn't qualify for admin. Max allowed = write. Requested admin exceeds max, grant write. (Note Security discrepancy but majority says full-time.)

Let me submit.
